qa.question: Is the Diesel Generators unit in Madison a backup power unit?
qa.finding: No document I found states the Backup Power value for this unit. The Madison Gas and Electric page at https://mge.com/about-mge/power-plants/power-sources did not contain the words backup generators when checked, so it could not be cited. EIA lists the unit as an operating internal combustion engine with very low output.
qa.recommendation: Leave Backup Power as no and leave its source empty. Ask the Madison Gas and Electric contact whether the units serve customer backup or utility peaking.
